The '''''Justice''''' was a [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80 ''Liberty'' type]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the ''Justice'' led the [[Rapid Response Task Force]] in the [[Battle of Mindor]]. It was later destroyed by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn's]] forces, and split into three parts. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was able to use his considerable Force skills to crash-land the bridge section on the surface of [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]].

==Description==
The ''Justice'' was of a unique design, like any Mon Cal ship. It had similarities to its sister ship, the [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], but possessed much larger [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bays]] for launching [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] craft, causing General Luke Skywalker to remark that the ship looked "a little bit pregnant." The ''Justice'' could carry up to ten starfighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]].<ref name="SoM" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Justice'' appeared for the first time in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', in the flight simulator skirmish ''8P Complex 2 Team Classic Conflict''. In the game the ship was classified as a [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]]. However the novel ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' stated that the ''Justice'' was the sister ship to the legendary [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], so a [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruiser]].

Luke's miraculous landing of the ''Justice'' mirrors [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] landing of the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]&mdash;the ship splits into pieces, its controls are made for alien species, etc.
